name: Silhouette Image Space Acceleration Structure (Mip Pyramid)
definition: Mip pyramid over each silhouette image used to accelerate voxel/silhouette coverage queries. Inspired by hierarchical z-buffer. Each pyramid level stores min and max values of 4 texels from next lower level, providing conservative bounds on silhouette values.
summary: The Silhouette Image Space Acceleration Structure accelerates voxelization by using mip pyramids of silhouette images to provide conservative bounds on visual hull intersections, avoiding per-voxel sampling.
